advancement.cataclysm_primed_soul.defeat: You subdued the raging white flames with sheer force.
Defeat the true hero long forgotten.
advancement.cataclysm_primed_soul.root.d: The First Step, The Last Step
boss_screen.cataclysm_primed_soul.ignis_: Nearby players suffer progressive reductions to armor and armor toughness.
Nullifies incoming attacks from the front and unleashes a ferocious counterattack upon repeated strikes.
When its health is depleted, it transitions to Phase 2, launching omnidirectional attacks with projectile barrages and white flames.
Ascends into the sky before executing a devastating dive bomb toward the surface.
The incarnation of ruin who mastered the abyssal fire, cloaked in a pure white soul. Its unrelenting heat pressure melts through any armor, rendering all protection obsolete.
Secure ample evasion mobility and healing methods to counter the armor reduction debuffs.
When the boss takes a guarding stance, heavy axe attacks can trigger a guard break.
In Phase 2, remain constantly vigilant against white flame blasts and ultra-high-speed charges.
boss_screen.cataclysm_primed_soul.maledi: Instantly teleports behind the attacker upon receiving a hit to deliver a deadly riposte.
Grabs a player with one hand, ascends into the air, and slams them down into the ground.
Summons phantoms that execute spear charges, mace smashes, and bow snipes.
Below 50% HP, its armor shatters, drastically boosting attack speed and offensive aggression.
The ancient king of a fallen realm who became a great sinner. He summons phantoms of his bygone relics, closing distance in an instant to strike.
Observe the telegraphing motions of the phantoms (Spear, Mace, Bow) to dodge in the appropriate direction.
Careless attacks during its stance will trigger an instant teleportation counter behind your back.
If caught by its grab attack, prepare to endure consecutive impacts and a lethal ground slam.
chat.cataclysm_primed_soul.ignis_prime.a: The excitement around me is building...
chat.cataclysm_primed_soul.ignis_prime.h: The heat transforms into unrelenting pressure, and the equipment begins to melt.
chat.cataclysm_primed_soul.ignis_prime.p: A pure white soul fills my vision. All protection has turned to ash...
dialogue.cataclysm_primed_soul.maledictu: The curse of ages... finally begins to fade.
Go, warrior. The crown was always a burden.
item.cataclysm_primed_soul.lavatein.desc: A sword that gains speed with every strike, its outer layer peeling away.
Applies debuffs to the target based on the three stages of release.
tooltip.cataclysm_primed_soul.abyssal_as: §6 If you offer it to the Altar of Fire again, something might happen.
tooltip.cataclysm_primed_soul.rusted_kni: §3You must offer a sacrifice at the tombstone of the king who became a great sinner—one of the relics of a king from ancient times.
